description: This file is a script that analyzes TypeScript source files to detect references to certain pairing-store identifiers and group authorization patterns, enforcing certain coding conventions related to group authorization logic.

methods.name: getDeclarationNameText
methods.description: Extracts the name text from a declaration identifier or pattern.

methods.name: containsPairingStoreSource
methods.description: Checks if a node contains references to pairing store identifiers or specific store-related call expressions.

methods.name: getCallName
methods.description: Retrieves the call name from a call expression node.

methods.name: isSuspiciousNormalizeWithStoreCall
methods.description: Detects calls to 'normalizeAllowFromWithStore' with specific properties indicating pairing store usage.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Traverses the source file's AST to find violations related to group-scoped variables/properties referencing pairing store identifiers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that collects violations in source files and outputs errors if violations are found.
